title: Product exclusions
statement: Input is an integer array. Return the product of every other element for each position. Empty input returns []. Do not use division.
inputFormat: One JSON value on a single line, with the fields described above. Read it using json.loads(input()).
outputFormat: One compact JSON value. Use print(json.dumps(answer, separators=(",", ":"))). Booleans must be JSON true/false. Arrays retain the stated order.
constraints: Array and string lengths are at most 200 unless stated otherwise.
Integers have absolute value at most 10,000 unless stated otherwise.
All inputs satisfy the stated preconditions.
